title: Precinct 2 Holiday Toy Drive Lets Laredo Students Earn Service Hours
excerpt: Webb County Constable Mike Villarreal's Precinct 2 office is hosting its annual holiday toy drive, and Laredo students can earn up to 30 community service hours by donating new, unwrapped toys.
content:
Webb County Constable Mike Villarreal's Precinct 2 office is hosting its annual holiday toy drive, and Laredo students can earn community service hours by donating new, unwrapped toys, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Students earn 10 service hours for one new, unwrapped toy valued at $10 or more, 20 hours for two toys and 30 hours for three, the Constable's office said. The hours can help students fulfill National Honor Society requirements, strengthen college applications and build their resumes.

Donations are being accepted through December at the Precinct 2 office, 901 S. Milmo Blvd., described as a red brick building. Drop-off hours are 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday. No specific end date was given.

Toys received after the Christmas giveaway may be saved for the precinct's Easter giveaway, according to the office.

For more information, the Precinct 2 office can be reached at 956-523-4780.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 18, 2026.
